connector.name: Audiobookshelf MCP
connector.registryDescription: Inspect and safely operate Audiobookshelf libraries over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image abs-mcp:0.6.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jeeftor account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ABS_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Audiobookshelf server.

env.name: ABS_API_KEY
env.description: Audiobookshelf API key or bearer token.

env.name: ABS_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to false to enable scan and cleanup tools.

env.name: ABS_TIMEOUT
env.description: Audiobookshelf request timeout as a Go duration or seconds.

env.name: ABS_FIXTURE_DIR
env.description: Optional local ABS fixture directory for fixture resources.

env.name: ABS_EXTRA_HEADERS_FILE
env.description: Optional JSON file containing extra request headers.

env.name: ABS_TLS_CA_CERT_FILE
env.description: Optional PEM CA bundle for private or corporate ABS TLS.

env.name: ABS_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY
env.description: Temporary TLS verification bypass for local troubleshooting.

env.name: ABS_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport to run at startup. Use stdio for local launchers or http for Streamable HTTP.

env.name: ABS_HTTP_PATH
env.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint path used when ABS_TRANSPORT=http.

env.name: ABS_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token required from Streamable HTTP MCP clients.
